objective: Establish a deterministic sparse contouring kernel whose output is exactly equivalent to dense fixed-Freudenthal marching tetrahedra on the same canonical lattice when supplied the same sign-changing cubes.
reason: Adaptive proof traversal may prune empty volume, but contour topology must not depend on whether empty cubes were omitted. X0 isolates that extraction invariant before any Knight/full-domain bakeoff.

kernel_contract.interpolation: linear zero interpolation on tetra edge
kernel_contract.degenerate_policy: fail closed for exact-zero lattice values in X0 fixtures; later production policy must type exact-zero handling explicitly

fixtures: sphere on a small canonical lattice
frozen_gates: sparse active-cube mesh canonical vertex set == dense all-cube mesh canonical vertex set
sparse active-cube canonical face set == dense all-cube canonical face set
no unmatched internal seam induced solely by sparse cube omission
all emitted vertices finite and inside the source lattice bounds
claim_boundary: X0 proves only sparse-vs-dense equivalence for the fixed MTet baseline. It does not claim MTet improves VF11 fidelity; historical regular MTet evidence already showed no material fidelity gain over MC. It is a topology/stitching baseline for the adaptive extractor transition.
